rationale: The bounded, localized product-semantics change warrants a structured slice. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced; Verified Change is also ineligible because ownership is distributed across three canonical owners and propagation is not deterministic.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
Product semantics impact is explicitly true, while runtime, policy, persistence, architecture, security, external API,
CLI contract, release, and cross-host impacts are false.
Three canonical owners and three source paths require scoped coordination.
Four derived paths exist and deterministic propagation is false.
Baseline is clean and deterministic validation is available.
No completed Brownfield analysis is supplied.
No stored quick_task context is supplied.
Any broader impact requires fail-closed escalation.
This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate, not an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
